svg.title: Explain an API in one visual story
svg.desc:
Explain an API in one visual story The request, response, and useful result are presented as one resolved narrative.
1. Send the request HTTP request Language: http GET /api/projects/chartforgex Accept: application/json
2. Inspect the response HTTP request Language: http GET /api/projects/chartforgex Accept: application/json JSON response Language: json { "name": "ChartForgeX", "status": "ready", "formats": ["svg", "png", "gif"] }
3. Use the returned capability JSON response Language: json { "name": "ChartForgeX", "status": "ready", "formats": ["svg", "png", "gif"] } Supported formats: SVG · PNG · GIF
Outcomes: - Supported formats are visible
